sentiment.rationale: The company delivered strong first-quarter results with organic sales growth of 2.9% and Base Business EPS up 7%, but forward guidance was mixed: net sales and EPS guidance were maintained, while gross profit margin guidance was lowered from 'up' to 'down' on both GAAP and non-GAAP bases. Management cited volatile macroeconomic conditions, slower category growth, and tariff impacts, which temper the positive operational momentum. The guidance revision on margins and cautious language on the environment prevent a positive score, but the maintained sales and EPS guidance and strong results keep it from being strongly negative.

summary.revenue: Net sales increased 8.4% to $5,324 million for Q1 2026, with organic sales growth of 2.9%.
summary.eps: GAAP diluted EPS decreased 6% to $0.80; Base Business diluted EPS increased 7% to $0.97.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2026: net sales expected up 2% to 6% (maintained), organic sales growth 1% to 4% (maintained), GAAP and Base Business gross profit margin now expected to be down (previously up), advertising expected up, and EPS growth expected (GAAP double-digit, Base Business low to mid-single-digit).
summary.margin: GAAP gross profit margin decreased 20 basis points to 60.6%; Base Business gross profit margin also decreased 20 basis points to 60.6%. Operating profit margin (GAAP) decreased 380 basis points to 18.1%; Base Business operating profit margin decreased 90 basis points to 21.3%.
key_risks: Volatile macroeconomic conditions and slower category growth expected to continue in 2026.
Impact of tariffs announced and finalized as of April 29, 2026, included in guidance.
Gross profit margin expected to be down for full year 2026 (revised from up).
Negative impact from lower private label pet food sales on organic sales growth.
Charges related to the Strategic Growth and Productivity Program increased to $350-$550 million (from $200-$300 million).
key_opportunities: Broad-based top and bottom-line growth with net sales and organic sales growth in every category and in four of five divisions.
Global market share leadership in toothpaste (41.1%) and manual toothbrushes (32.6%).
Expansion of the Strategic Growth and Productivity Program to drive future growth and support 2030 strategy.
Positive impact from foreign exchange on net sales guidance (low-single-digit).

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: Management expressed confidence in the strong start and resilience ('We delivered a strong start to 2026... underscore the resilience of our business model') but also acknowledged a difficult operating environment and cautious outlook ('we expect the volatile macroeconomic conditions and slower category growth to continue in 2026').
